body: `get_processor_name()` looks for a `model name` in the `/proc/cpuinfo` which seems to be missing in this case.

Yes, apparently this is quite common in non-x86 architectures. marcan, one of the Asahi developers, posted something about it a while ago if I remember correctly. I'll see if I can find it to help find the correct way to implement this for most systems

EDIT: [Found it](https://social.treehouse.systems/@marcan/113550506348329045). Unfortunately, there doesn't seem to be a standard way except for maybe `lscpu` which, in case of M1 results in
